d: Dabang Delhi K.C. crushed Tamil Thalaivas by a 39-26 scoreline in match 42 of Pro Kabaddi League Season 11. In this mighty battle of north vs south, Ashu Malik blew out the defenders by scoring 12 raid points while the combo of Yogesh and Ashish Malik dominated the raiders to score 14 tackle points.
